3.1.0.summary: Fixes from the 3.0.0 field test (#72). No breaking changes.

behaviour_changes.note: reconcile --apply makes a docs(reconcile) commit and, only when an index file changed, a separate docs(index) commit; applied_commit is the docs commit.
fix-retrieval-fields --apply, maintain --fix, metadata-sync, archive and unarchive rewrite only the frontmatter keys they own.

3.1.1.summary: Follow-up to 3.1.0 (#74): fewer false generic-secret findings, faster hewtd index after a one-doc edit. No breaking changes.

3.1.2.summary: Follow-up to 3.1.1 (#76): one word test for secret exemptions, per-doc cache keyed on the last code commit. The first run after upgrading is a full rebuild.

3.1.3.summary: Follow-up to 3.1.2 (#77): speed only, output is byte-identical to a cold build.

3.1.4.summary: Follow-up to 3.1.3 (#80): structured values such as datetime.utcnow() are no longer generic-secret.

3.1.5.summary: Follow-up to 3.1.4 (#82): incremental graph index after a code commit; speed only, an old cache is rebuilt once.

3.1.6.summary: Fixes #84, #85 and #86: not-checkable refs, merged sources on apply, an accepted rewrite replaces the doc body.

behaviour_changes.note: reconcile --apply merges an entry's sources into the doc's existing sources instead of replacing them.
reconcile --apply of an accepted rewrite replaces the doc body with the draft in the batch commit (before, the draft was only written under .hewtd/reconcile/drafts/).
reconcile --write-review with explicitly named docs includes docs in the clean lane.
refs that could never be repo files (gitignored paths, placeholders, regexes, external_refs) are unknown, not missing.

3.1.7.summary: Fixes #90: external_refs merged on apply, status reports covered refs, help refresh.

behaviour_changes.note: reconcile --apply merges external_refs from a review entry into the doc's frontmatter (existing first, deduped).
reconcile --write-review gives each non-secret entry a read-only missing list and an empty external_refs list.
reconcile --status adds a refs-in-reviewed-docs line read from .hewtd/graph.json.
a metadata-only verdict (fields, phrases) no longer replaces an earlier review on apply; last_verified is neither stamped nor cleared by it.
reconcile --status prints how many reviewed docs had metadata updated since.
reconcile.schema_sources also reads SQLAlchemy and Django models (.py); a pattern that matches no tracked file gives a triage warning.

3.2.0.summary: Cold rotation (#97) and every new or changed doc ends reconciled (#98).

config_keys.note: the pre-commit reconcile --changed --check blocks, instead of warning, while docs are unreviewed (#98)

behaviour_changes.note: integrate no longer fills purpose from the first paragraph; every new or changed doc ends with reconcile --changed --write-review, a judged entry, then reconcile --apply (which stamps last_verified).
integrate prints the doc's lane and next step, refuses to overwrite a different doc at the target path, and -d means that domain plus the doc's own.

3.2.0.hook_block: The pre-commit block (hewtd hooks install) also runs `hewtd reconcile --changed --check --cached`; hooks install upgrades an older block in place (#98).
3.2.0.template_changes: New templates/doc.template.md (title, tier, domains, purpose, symptoms, sources, optional external_refs) (#98).

3.2.1.summary: Fixes #101: a cold promote re-added every baselined secret finding under a new path.

config_keys.note: reconcile --promote allowlists the cold root in .gitleaks.toml and .secrets.baseline (#101)

behaviour_changes.note: reconcile --promote edits (or creates) .gitleaks.toml and edits .secrets.baseline in the promote commit; opt out with reconcile.cold_scanner_allowlist: false.

3.2.2.summary: Fixes #103: an applied rewrite counted as unreviewed forever. No key changes.

behaviour_changes.note: a rewrite whose draft has landed counts as reviewed until the doc is edited again; this changes what reconcile --changed, --next and --status, audit's DOCS_UNREVIEWED and the pre-commit check report.
